message.content:
**Top Sushi Restaurants in Los Angeles (as of 2026)**  

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights | Price Range |
|------------|--------------|------------|-------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic Edomae style, fresh tuna & salmon, long‑standing reputation. | $30–$70 per person |
| **Sushi Park** | West Hollywood | Innovative rolls, high‑quality fish, lively atmosphere. | $25–$60 per person |
| **Sushi Ota** | Koreatown | Small, intimate setting; meticulous preparation; excellent omakase. | $35–$80 per person |
| **Sushi Kappo** | Downtown LA | Contemporary kaiseki experience, seasonal ingredients. | $40–$90 per person |
| **Sushi Tetsu** | West Hollywood | Chef‑driven menu, creative combinations, strong focus on sustainability. | $30–$70 per person |

### Why These Stand Out
- **Quality & Freshness:** All use only the freshest fish, often sourced directly from Japan or local suppliers.
- **Chef Expertise:** Many have chefs with Michelin or Jiro‑style training.
- **Atmosphere:** From intimate kaiseki rooms to vibrant, modern spaces, each offers a unique dining experience.
- **Reviews & Awards:** Consistently high ratings on Yelp, Google, and food blogs; some have received Michelin stars or other accolades.

### Quick Tips for Visiting
- **Reservations:** Especially for sushi parks and kaiseki places, book well in advance.
- **Dress Code:** Some upscale spots require smart casual attire.
- **Tipping:** In Japan, tipping isn’t customary, but in LA it’s appreciated—15–20% is standard for good service.

Enjoy your sushi adventure in Los Angeles!
